weakest_interface: ZERO_HEADROOM: n_cross_sentence_gold==0 (UD relation gold is intra-sentential by construction; discourse context cannot recover a cross-sentence gold relation)

SURFACE_PRONOUN_GOLD: overlay recovered 3 pronoun-subject triples, 0 match UD gold (gold keeps the surface pronoun lemma 'it'/'he'/'she' as the argument, so an entity-resolved triple mismatches by construction -> resolution only lowers precision)
overlay did NOT raise precision or recall vs UD gold -> single-relation precision on sentence-level gold does not use discourse state

prereg.hard_pass: OVERLAY_ATTRIBUTE precision >= BASE_OFF precision + 0.03 (no per-seed precision loss) OR OVERLAY_ATTRIBUTE recall >= BASE_OFF recall + 0.03 -- discourse context measurably reopens the precision/coverage door on the base parser's REAL UD gold, across seeds
prereg.hard_fail: delta_precision<=0 AND delta_recall<=0 (no improvement) -> honest null: single-relation precision on sentence-level gold does not use discourse state; redirect to coref-gold grounding + BET-3 entity-grid discourse coherence
prereg.middle: otherwise (mixed: one metric holds, the other within noise)
prereg.reachability: HARD_PASS is reachable-in-principle iff the corpus affords headroom (n_cross_sentence_gold>0 OR resolution can match gold); UD-EWT surface-pronoun sentence-level gold structurally affords ~0 -- MEASURED here, not assumed

design_gate.real_baseline: ie_extract_open per-sentence, overlay OFF (closed WITHOUT context)
design_gate.can_fail: HARD_PASS vs HARD_FAIL both reachable; genuine null is first-class
design_gate.difficulty_on: multi-sentence real UD-EWT prose; 12pct sentences pron-subject
design_gate.one_variable: overlay context OFF vs RECENCY vs ATTRIBUTE; same extractor/corpus/gold

prereg.parser_class: glass-box rule extractor (NLTK PerceptronTagger) + symbolic discourse overlay; NO LLM
prereg.crlb_n/a: symbolic extraction/resolution measurement; no phasor decode noise floor
